'''Makk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] who was the bridge weapons officer of the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|battlecruiser]] [[Valor (Sith cruiser)|''Valor'']] that belonged to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. Makk was one of the officers under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jard]] during and immediately after the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].
